definitions.gloss: offshore, open sea, off the coast
definitions.explanation: The area of sea some distance from the shore. Used to describe locations in the water away from land.

examples.japanese: {沖合|おきあい}に{船|ふね}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see a ship offshore.

examples.japanese: {沖合|おきあい}で{大|おお}きなクジラが{泳|およ}いでいた。
examples.english: A large whale was swimming offshore.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{沖合|おきあい}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the waters offshore.

notes:
{沖合|おきあい} is composed of {沖|おき} (open sea, offshore) + {合|あい} (area around).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {沖合|おきあい}で (offshore, in the open sea)
- {沖合|おきあい}に (out to sea)
- ～の{沖合|おきあい} (off the coast of ~)

RELATED WORDS:
- {沖|おき} (open sea — also used alone)
- {岸|きし} (shore, bank — opposite direction)
